name: c0-net-zero-root
description: Root project runner for C0 Net-Zero

scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.setup: cd c0_frontend && npm install && cd ../c0_backend && python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .\venv\Scripts\python.exe manage.py migrate
